prose: Techmeme’s excerpt of South China Morning Post reporting says Alibaba filtered Qwen4-Max training data to reduce offensive cyber capabilities and chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear risks. The supplied link led to the publication’s homepage, not the article. This records a vendor safety claim, not independent evidence that those capabilities were removed or that safeguards resist adversarial use.
highlights: Feed link resolves to a homepage
Mitigation claims are not safety guarantees
